hook: Preston moved from running two federal agencies during the 2008 financial crisis to leading Goodwill Industries, where he has directed the organization's push to use AI-enabled training tools to help workers displaced by automation move into new careers, applying crisis-era public administration experience to AI's labor disruption.
name: Steve Preston

quote.text: The jobs of the future will require constant reskilling, and the organizations that succeed will be the ones that make that reskilling accessible to everyone, not just the already advantaged.
quote.context: A recurring theme in Preston's public remarks on Goodwill's workforce mission in the AI era

timeline.event: Becomes President and CEO of Goodwill Industries International

timeline.impact: Applies workforce policy experience to automation-driven job transitions

quick_facts: President and CEO of Goodwill Industries International
Served as U.S. Secretary of Housing and Urban Development (2008-2009) under President George W. Bush
Previously Administrator of the U.S. Small Business Administration (2006-2008)
Led Goodwill's expansion of AI-enabled job training and workforce reskilling programs

achievements.title: U.S. Secretary of Housing and Urban Development (2008-2009)
achievements.impact: Led HUD through the depths of the 2008 financial crisis and the onset of the foreclosure crisis.

achievements.title: Administrator, U.S. Small Business Administration (2006-2008)
achievements.impact: Directed federal small-business lending and disaster relief programs, including Hurricane Katrina recovery lending.

achievements.title: President and CEO, Goodwill Industries International
achievements.impact: Leads one of the largest nonprofit workforce-development networks in the U.S., expanding job-training programs as automation reshapes entry-level labor markets.

achievements.title: Expansion of Goodwill's AI-enabled workforce reskilling initiatives
achievements.impact: Directed Goodwill's efforts to prepare workers in roles vulnerable to automation for AI-adjacent and technology-enabled careers.
